To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The proposed ResASPP Unets model with 11 layer and 64 IFMS outperforms other models, including the ASPP U-net model, the U-net, CNN and SVM model, for urban land cover and land classification based on VHR satellite imagery.

the proposed deep learning models are able to achieve high classification accuracy and robustness for VHR imagery, and the ResASPP model outperforms the ASPP model in terms of classification accuracy.
the proposed ASPP Unets and ResASPP U-Net models outperformed state-of-the-art models in urban land cover classification.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of deep neural network models for urban land use and land cover classification.
the development of novel deep learning models for urban land cover and land cover classification based VHR satellite imagery.
the use of deep learning models for land cover classification based very high resolution satellite imagery.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ResASPS Unet model with an 11 layer depth and 64 initial feature maps based on 8 bands of WV2 imagery achieved the highest classification accuracy.
the proposed deep learning models, especially ResASPP Unets are promising and efficient for urban land use and land cover classification based VHR satellite imagery.
the proposed ResASPP U-net model is superior to the ASPP U-net model, and the proposed models outperform the state of the arts in terms of accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in order to improve the classification accuracy of urban land cover classification from VHR satellite imagery, the ASPP Unet architecture with the atrous spatial pyramid pool technique is a promising approach.
, the proposed models have the potential to be utilized as a powerful tool for urban land cover and land classification, and can be applied to other VHR imagery.
, in order to achieve high accuracy in urban land cover classification, a deep neural network model is required, and a multi scale model with residual unit is the best choice.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed ASPP Unets are able to extract multi scale deep features from VHR images, and are robust to different input image band combinations, and can be applied for efficient and accurate urban land cover classification.
the proposed models can be used to produce high accuracy urban land cover classification products based on VHR satellite imagery.
the ASPP Unet or ResASPP Unets can be used as a general framework to improve the classification performance of deep learning based models for urban land cover mapping.
